preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total points k must be between 0 and 100,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not exists_valid_sequence(n, k) else all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1; otherwise, output n distinct integers each between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: sum(gcd(int(stdout.split()[i]), int(stdout.split()[i+1])) for i in range(0, len(stdout.split()) - 1, 2)) == k
postconditions.description: The total points scored by Bimokh must equal k.
